{
  "schema": "harness.documentation-policy/v1",
  "human": {
    "include": [
      "**/*.md"
    ],
    "exclude": [
      "machine/**",
      "LICENSES/**",
      "core/LICENSES/**",
      "core/examples/verification/**",
      "core/examples/research-support/plan-seal/PLAN.md",
      "AGENTS.md"
    ],
    "writing": [
      "State purpose, installation, usage, examples, design choices and contribution paths in plain language.",
      "Keep real scientific conditions and observed results; write useful scope positively.",
      "Link file indexes where useful. Move integrity checks, raw identifiers, audit caveats and repetitive defensive claims into structured machine records."
    ],
    "forbidden_boilerplate": [
      "不保证",
      "不代表",
      "不能据此",
      "不构成",
      "不等于",
      "不意味着",
      "does not guarantee",
      "does not imply",
      "does not constitute",
      "not a claim",
      "not a certification"
    ],
    "forbidden_verification_terms": [
      "SHA-256",
      "SHA256",
      "checksum",
      "哈希",
      "校验和",
      "verify_checkpoint.py",
      "verify_release.py"
    ],
    "forbid_archive_pointer_targets": true,
    "forbid_visible_hex_identifiers": true,
    "forbidden_link_prefixes": [
      "https://github.com/vvcchh0/BioInformaticsHarness-research-archive",
      "https://chatgpt.com/c/",
      "codex://",
      "file://"
    ]
  },
  "machine": {
    "root": "machine/",
    "preferred_formats": [
      "json",
      "jsonl"
    ],
    "historical_records": "Retain original frozen artifacts under their existing historical scope; new metadata explicitly records source, status and access.",
    "source_index": "machine/source-design-index.jsonl",
    "source_index_required": [
      "id",
      "sources",
      "design",
      "borrowing",
      "implementation",
      "acceptance"
    ],
    "legacy_fixtures": [
      "core/examples/verification/**",
      "core/examples/research-support/plan-seal/PLAN.md"
    ],
    "agent_entrypoint": "AGENTS.md",
    "original_document_retention": {
      "path": "machine/document-notes/",
      "schema": "harness.document-notes/v1",
      "original_fields": [
        "source_text",
        "source_commit",
        "source_sha256"
      ],
      "later_revisions": "Append dated technical notes or use machine/history; preserve the original-source fields."
    }
  },
  "legal": {
    "preserve_verbatim": [
      "LICENSE",
      "LICENSES/**",
      "NOTICE",
      "core/LICENSE",
      "core/LICENSES/**",
      "core/NOTICE"
    ],
    "licensing_explanations": "State attribution, rights, and practical use in human prose; retain detailed license mappings in machine manifests."
  },
  "release": {
    "frozen_tag": "v0.1.0-alpha.2",
    "documentation_revision": "2026-10-24",
    "new_docs_do_not_rewrite_published_assets": true
  },
  "new_file_licenses": {
    "machine/document-notes/**": "CC-BY-4.0",
    "machine/source-design-index.jsonl": "CC-BY-4.0",
    "machine/history/**": "CC-BY-4.0",
    "machine/documentation-policy.json": "Apache-2.0",
    "machine/schemas/**": "Apache-2.0",
    "tools/**": "Apache-2.0",
    "tests/**": "Apache-2.0",
    "**/*.md": "CC-BY-4.0",
    "machine/**": "CC-BY-4.0",
    "machine/documentation-operations.json": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/scripts/research_support/*.py": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/tests/test_task_context.py": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/tests/test_resource_loop.py": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/machine/design/**": "CC-BY-4.0",
    "examples/splice/resource_readiness.py": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/scripts/acquisition/**": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/config/source-routing.json": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/tests/acquisition/**": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/machine/tools/**": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/examples/research-support/preparation/*.template.json": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/examples/research-support/preparation/*.example.json": "CC-BY-4.0",
    "core/tests/research_support/test_research_cycle.py": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/examples/research-support/research-cycle/*.template.json": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/examples/research-support/research-cycle/fixtures/**": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/examples/research-support/research-cycle/offline-fixture/*.json": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/tests/research_support/test_review_coverage.py": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/examples/research-support/preparation/coverage-example/*.json": "Apache-2.0",
    "core/examples/research-support/preparation/coverage-example/*.txt": "Apache-2.0"
  },
  "license_scope_updates": [
    {
      "date": "2026-10-22",
      "reason": "D51/D52 add first-party task/control code, tests, machine design documentation and a resource-readiness consumer; preserve existing project code and documentation licenses.",
      "scopes": {
        "core/scripts/research_support/*.py": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/tests/test_task_context.py": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/tests/test_resource_loop.py": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/machine/design/**": "CC-BY-4.0",
        "examples/splice/resource_readiness.py": "Apache-2.0"
      }
    },
    {
      "date": "2026-10-22",
      "reason": "D53 first-party acquisition transport and editable machine record templates, narrative plan/review documentation kept under CC BY 4.0.",
      "scopes": {
        "core/scripts/acquisition/**": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/config/source-routing.json": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/tests/acquisition/**": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/machine/tools/**": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/examples/research-support/preparation/*.template.json": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/examples/research-support/preparation/*.example.json": "CC-BY-4.0"
      }
    },
    {
      "date": "2026-10-22",
      "reason": "D54 adds first-party cycle/discussion machine templates, a native readiness checker and fictional offline test fixtures. Human guidance and design narrative remain CC BY 4.0.",
      "scopes": {
        "core/tests/research_support/test_research_cycle.py": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/examples/research-support/research-cycle/*.template.json": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/examples/research-support/research-cycle/fixtures/**": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/examples/research-support/research-cycle/offline-fixture/*.json": "Apache-2.0"
      }
    },
    {
      "date": "2026-10-23",
      "reason": "D55 adds first-party optional coverage checker, record template and explicitly fictional example inputs; no external paper bodies or third-party rows redistributed.",
      "scopes": {
        "core/tests/research_support/test_review_coverage.py": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/examples/research-support/preparation/coverage-example/*.json": "Apache-2.0",
        "core/examples/research-support/preparation/coverage-example/*.txt": "Apache-2.0"
      }
    }
  ]
}
